The '''NRSS ''Founder''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] affiliated to the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]] (also known as [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] Scout Service or NRSS). This ship, that had [[solar fin]]s, docked on the [[Outer Region Foxar Scout Base]].

At some point, it began a mission to survey [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in eight different [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], searching for valuable natural resources such as mineral veins, and then return to Foxar Base. The crew included [[Deeve]], [[Jarsa]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[Effcee]] and [[REM-02]]. They only had to find one good vein and the whole trip would cover expenses, but the first five planets proved to be unfruitful. Besides, the solar fins of the ''Founder'' were damaged by [[Mynock/Legends|Mynocks]].

Deeve left the ''Founder'' to scout [[Unidentified planet (Deeve)|the fifth planet]] in their list. As it had a hostile, but breathable, [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], Deeve was cladded with protective gear and a mask before he left the ''Founder''. Initially Jarsa was intended to remain on board to contact Deeve through [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], but she later decided to fix the solar fin while Effcee substituted her.

Deeve contacted the ''Founder'' before starting the survey, and again later because he had made [[first contact]] with a [[Unidentified tentacled being|purportedly-hostile, tentacled local]].
